stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 33 to give this paper a more effective closing?

options.label: A
options.text: At sunrise, I would be the first one up to get up and get ready for our morning hike.

options.label: B
options.text: While resting, I thought about my first shooting star that was full of color.

options.label: C
options.text: With my goal accomplished, I closed my eyes and smiled from ear to ear.

options.label: D
options.text: When I drifted off to sleep in my sleeping bag, I dreamed about returning home Monday.
